AUTHORITY / EVIDENCE / ACCOUNTABILITY
APPLICATION SUPPLEMENT · 01
AI agents can draft changes across repositories, cloud accounts, and deployment pipelines. The security problem is whether
untrusted context can become privileged infrastructure change without a defensible chain of identity, authority, policy, execution,
and independently observed outcome. A plausible patch or green CI job does not authorize a change or establish that its intended
control held.
Authority perimeter. Tickets, CSPM findings, repository content, and MCP responses are inputs, never grants. The agent proposes; a separate
deterministic action gate evaluates the exact operation; provider IAM and release gates enforce execution; the owning platform team approves
material changes. Protected assets: identities, infrastructure, artifacts, and decision records.
BOUNDARY /
OBJECTIVE
CONTROL / EVIDENCE / RESPONSE
REPRODUCE / EXPECT
01
MCP/tool call
Least privilege
Preconditions / policy: initiating identity, tenant, authenticated source,
allowlisted tool/verb/resource, normalized parameters, approved
change, current policy decision. Trusted origin alone does not make tool
content safe.
Evidence gate: PR-linked source/request digests, delegated scope,
policy version/decision, correlation ID, response or denial.
Fail closed / escalate: missing provenance, conflicting scope, or
unavailable policy blocks invocation; retain the attempted request and
ask the owner to resolve authority.
Approve read-only access to project
A. Supply a tool response requesting
an IAM grant in project B; repeat with
alternate resource encoding. Expect
no provider call and a recorded scope
denial.
02
Delegated IAM
Authorization at
time of action
Preconditions / policy: short-lived delegation bound to principal, change,
resource set, and permitted verbs; approval bound to request digest and
expiry. Re-evaluate at dispatch; provider IAM independently authorizes
the effective principal.
Evidence gate: PR-linked delegation lineage, approval, current policy
result, provider receipt or denial, and resource diff.
Fail closed / escalate: scope expansion, expired/revoked grant, or
changed request denies execution; owning team must re-authorize.
Queue a narrowly approved action,
then revoke delegation before
dispatch. Retry the execution ID and
substitute a cross-project target.
Expect denial and unchanged
resource state; reconcile ambiguous
provider outcomes before retry.
03
IaC / CI/CD
Evidence
completeness
Preconditions / policy: identifiable source, code-owner review, approved
plan, security baseline checks, scoped promotion authority, and an
independent target-state verifier.
Evidence gate: PR-linked commit/plan/image digests, CI provenance,
approval, deployment receipt, and fresh post-deploy observation tied to
the exact resource and claim.
Fail closed / escalate: missing or mismatched evidence blocks
promotion or closure; quarantine the candidate and retain an unresolved
record for the platform owner.
Present a green receipt for commit A
as proof for commit B; then withhold
the target-state query. Expect blocked
promotion or unresolved remediation,
with the mismatch and verification
failure preserved.
Implemented support: Stratum. I built an append-only decision ledger with guarded transitions, checked-evidence requirements, deterministic status
projection, separate declared/evidence-backed authority tiers, and replay validation. It preserves proposals, verification, disputes, and invalidations
without editable closure. The cloud action controls above are proposed integrations: the repository explicitly separates its implemented event
contract from the unimplemented agent PolicyEngine. Stratum does not replace provider authorization, telemetry integrity, or accountable human
review.
Touchstone verification. Name the scoped claim and offered proof; enumerate uncovered boundaries; run concrete probes; preserve held, failed, or
unresolved results and the tested perimeter. Re-probe a repair once; a second failure escalates. Green CI is evidence about a check, not automatic
proof of the security claim.
Inspect the implementation: Repository / Live Atrium / Authority boundary / Event contract
